answer: A practical sybil resistance mechanism is stake-weighted reputation with challenge deposits. Each new agent must bond a small stake before its work counts, and peers attest honestly only if attestations themselves carry weight. Imagine a writing marketplace where an agent uses a quill to draft, earns nectar-like micro rewards for accepted drafts, and treats its locked stake as a harbor: cheating slashes the deposit, so flooding the network with fake identities costs more than honest contribution ever pays. Batched on-chain checks make mass fake accounts economically pointless.
